description: List all asynchronous operations for the company. Non-admin users only see operations they created, unless the request is filtered to a company-readable operation type (for example `bulk_create_and_initialize_projects`) — either directly via `operation_type` or via `parent_id` — in which case matching operations are returned with a restricted payload that omits `result`, `error`, and `created_by_id`.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Return child operations of the specified parent operation.

parameters.name: operation_type
parameters.description: Return operations of the specified type.

parameters.name: started_after
parameters.description: Return operations that started after this timestamp.

parameters.name: started_before
parameters.description: Return operations that started before this timestamp.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return operations with the specified status.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Return operations associated with the specified project.

data.description: Asynchronous operations matching the request filters.

items.description: Asynchronous operation summary for list responses.

operation_type.description: Kind of asynchronous work this operation performs.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the operation started. Null if it has not started.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the operation finished. Null if it has not completed.

error.description: Failure details when the operation failed. Null otherwise.

result.description: Operation-specific result. See the initiating API for the result format.

context.description: Opaque internal context for the operation.

created_by_id.description: Login information ID of the user who created the operation.

project_id.description: ID of the project the operation belongs to, if any

parent_id.description: ID of the parent operation, if this operation is a child of a batch operation

failure_details.description: Why this operation failed, when the failure was recorded with a reason. Populated for rows of a bulk create that were rejected before a project was attempted, or that failed while initializing. Nul...
